mechanism: Moxifloxacin can cause QT prolongation and rare dysrhythmias; ramipril may potentiate hypotension and electrolyte abnormalities, increasing cardiac risk in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum potassium, and renal function; use with caution in patients with baseline QT prolongation or electrolyte disturbances; consider alternative antibiotic if QT risk factors present.
